exposure: First-trimester maternal markers (pregnancy-associated plasma protein-A, free beta human chorionic gonadotropin, nuchal translucency)
cohort: The study included pregnant individuals categorized into a fetal growth restriction (FGR) group and a non-FGR group.
finding: Early screening markers combined with perinatal characteristics have better diagnostic value in predicting fetal growth restriction (FGR).
birth_weight: Not an inclusion criterion for the overall cohort; 'low birth weight' was identified as an associated factor with FGR, and newborn weight was an outcome measure.
gest_age: Not explicitly stated as an inclusion criterion for the whole cohort; first-trimester markers were measured.
